title: Bihar man beheads sister-in-law over delay in serving food, hangs head from tree
content: A woman was allegedly killed by her brother-in-law in Jehanabad district on Tuesday. The accused reportedly attacked her with an axe after a dispute over food. He then allegedly hung her severed head from a banyan tree near his home. Villagers discovered the gruesome scene and alerted the local police. The accused was apprehended by villagers and handed over to the authorities.

title: 'Why is Amit Shah scared?' Rahul on 'brutal' violence against student protesters
content: Rahul Gandhi intensified his attack on Union home minister Amit Shah. He alleged that Shah's absence from Parliament reeks of guilt. Gandhi demanded a Supreme Court-monitored probe into alleged police brutalities. He shared videos purportedly showing police action against student protesters. Opposition MPs also protested alleged police action and temple donation embezzlement.

title: Ground zero of Assam’s flood fury: Village vanishes in an hour; toll rises to 78
content: Hiloni Nepali Khuti village in Sivasagar district was destroyed by floods. Torrential rain in Nagaland caused the Dikhow river to overflow its banks. The devastating floodwaters swept away homes and nearly four thousand cattle. Residents are now trying to rebuild their lives with little hope remaining. Many families lost their dairy farming livelihoods to the raging waters.

title: Jasprit Bumrah, Shubman Gill easing back to full fitness
content: TOI understands that Bumrah will begin gradually increasing his bowling workload after suffering an impact injury during the ODI series in England, while Gill has sought help from specialists outside the BCCI for his chronic neck problem.

title: 'Proud of railways, want to be proud of govt promises too': Wangchuk
content: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk praised Indian Railways for its services. He urged the government to honor commitments made to student protesters. The recent NEET-UG paper leak debate was welcomed by the activist. Wangchuk also highlighted the success of peaceful non-violent resistance. The student-led agitation concluded after the government accepted key demands.

title: Steve Jobs once told Oracle founder Larry Ellison to not buy Apple
content: Larry Ellison planned to buy Apple for about five billion dollars then. Steve Jobs rejected this offer, preferring to return through NeXT. Jobs insisted on leading Apple from the moral high ground, not for financial gain. Ellison learned leadership from Jobs's decision to prioritize principles over profit. This choice ultimately led Apple to become the world's most valuable company.

title: Police empowered to use pellet guns in exceptional situations: SC
content: The Supreme Court observed that when in extreme violent situations police are permitted to use bullets if violence does not get controlled by lathicharge and tear gas, how can they be barred from using pellet guns if a protest, which has turned violent after being hijacked by miscreants for ulterior purposes.

title: 11 police personnel killed in overnight attack in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
content: A major militant attack occurred overnight on a police post in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. Eleven police personnel and fifteen attackers died during the fierce exchange of gunfire. The Khazina police post in Hangu district was the target of this significant assault. Security forces fought back, killing the militants and repelling the attack. This incident highlights the ongoing rise in militant violence in the region.

title: 'Jana Nayagan': Vijay and Pooja Hegde starrer stays steady
content: Jana Nayagan continues its strong box office performance, crossing Rs 150 crore net. The Vijay starrer is holding steady and showing good collections on weekdays. Industry trackers anticipate a further boost during the upcoming second weekend. With no major competition, the film is expected to attract family audiences. Makers may soon release an official box office update for eager fans.

title: Claude outage: Anthropic confirms elevated errors across models
content: Anthropic confirmed widespread outages affecting its Claude AI assistant and API services. Users reported receiving "529 Overloaded" errors as requests failed across multiple models. The company identified the issue and worked to restore services after disruptions occurred. Most Claude models have since recovered, but some users may still experience errors. The disruption impacted the Claude chatbot and third-party applications relying on its API.

title: Trump invites 16-year-old California lifeguard hero to White House
content: President Donald Trump has invited 16-year-old California lifeguard Ryder Williams and his family to the White House after the teenager rescued a young boy from powerful waves at Seabright State Beach. Trump said Williams deserves a high civilian honour for his bravery. The dramatic rescue, captured on video, has drawn widespread praise from officials, witnesses and social media users, with many calling the rookie lifeguard true hero.

title: Oklahoma woman rented out late father’s home, then lost it for a year
content: A Tulsa woman faced a year-long legal battle after a tenant changed locks on her father's home. The tenant falsely claimed he had purchased the property for a small sum. Police could not intervene as the dispute was deemed civil, not criminal. A judge recently granted a default judgment in the owner's favor, allowing her to regain possession. This case highlights the complexities and emotional toll of informal property arrangements.

title: Satya Nadella's new headache: Disney dumps GitHub Copilot
content: Disney is dropping GitHub Copilot and several AI coding tools in the US. The company will adopt OpenAI's Codex as its coding assistant. Disney is also retaining access to Anthropic's Claude Enterprise and Cursor. Two Amazon tools, Kiro and Q, will also be dropped. Claude will no longer be accessible through Amazon Web Services Bedrock.

title: Russia launches overnight ballistic missile attack on Ukraine, killing 13
content: Russia launched a ballistic missile attack on Kyiv, causing explosions and casualties. Ukraine's drone campaign targeted Russian logistics, damaging a major online retailer's warehouse. Poland scrambled fighter jets to protect its airspace during the missile strikes. President Zelenskyy appealed for more air defence missiles from allies. These attacks continue to strain Russia's economy and banking sector.

title: Ajinkya Rahane fights back tears as he bids farewell to international cricket
content: Ajinkya Rahane signed off his Test career with 5,077 runs at an average of 38.46, including 12 centuries and 26 half-centuries. In 90 ODIs, he scored 2,962 runs at 35.26, with three centuries and 24 fifties, while he made 375 runs in 20 T20Is. The right-handed batter made his India debut against England in 2011.

title: 'Armed with a sword & knife': Man attacks ex-landlord couple, kills woman's sister
content: A former tenant attacked his ex-landlord's family with a sword and knife. The violent assault resulted in one woman's death and two serious injuries. Sangeeta Chaudhary died after her throat was slit with a sword. The elderly couple, Dharmapal and Vanita Dahat, sustained severe injuries during the attack. Police have registered a case of murder and attempt to murder against the accused.

title: BJP workers clash with police outside AAP office, demand Punjab minister resign
content: BJP workers protested outside the Aam Aadmi Party office in Delhi. They demanded the Punjab Education Minister's resignation over a pharmacy exam irregularity. Police arrested several individuals involved in an alleged cheating racket. The Punjab Chief Minister stated no competitive exam paper had leaked. The opposition criticized the state government's handling of the situation.

title: 'Criticise govt, don't denigrate India': Harish Salve on dissent and social media
content: Speaking at the AK Sen Memorial Lecture and Photograph Unveiling Ceremony organised by the Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA), Salve said holding those in power accountable is necessary in a constitutional democracy. Several senior members of the legal fraternity attended the ceremony. SCBA President and Senior Advocate Vikas Singh paid tribute to Sen's contribution to the legal profession, while Attorney General for India R. Venkataramani also spoke about his legacy.

title: Is Pakistan facilitating Chinese missile shipments to Iran? Islamabad responds
content: Pakistan's military has strongly denied reports of facilitating Chinese weapons transit to Iran.  These claims emerged amid ongoing tensions between Iran and the United States.  The Pakistani army dismissed all such speculations as baseless and untrue.  This situation highlights Pakistan's careful balancing act between China and Washington.  The denial comes after reports suggested Iran would receive air defense systems soon.

title: 'Cap 278 signing off': Ajinkya Rahane retires from international cricket
content: Former India captain Ajinkya Rahane has announced his retirement from international cricket. He shared this news through a video message posted on his Instagram account. Rahane represented India in all three formats during his extensive international career. He played 85 Test matches, 90 ODIs, and 20 T20Is for the country. Rahane was also part of India's historic Test series win in Australia in 2020-21.

title: Explained: Why Neeraj Chopra's road to CWG 2026 gold could be difficult
content: Neeraj Chopra begins his bid for a second Commonwealth Games javelin gold in Glasgow, but faces one of the toughest fields of his career. Rivals including Arshad Nadeem, Anderson Peters and Rumesh Tharanga make the competition highly competitive. Returning from a back injury, Neeraj will hope to rediscover his best form after finishing fourth at the Doha Diamond League.

title: India's Russian crude imports may hit record 3m barrels per day: Here's why
content: If shipping through the Red Sea remains unaffected, Indian refiners will continue to have an important supply cushion through Saudi Arabia's East-West (Yanbu) pipeline, which has recently been supplying around 300,000-500,000 barrels per day (kbd) of crude.

title: US to procure 14 submarines for $76 billion, nearly as much as India's defence budget
content: The United States is investing significantly in its submarine fleet to counter China's growing naval power. This major procurement includes new Virginia-class attack and Columbia-class ballistic missile submarines. India is also enhancing its undersea capabilities with Arihant-class SSBNs and planned conventional submarines. Pakistan is modernizing its submarine force by adding new Hangor-class vessels. These developments highlight a global shift towards strengthening underwater military presence.

title: 'Frustration of their failure': Ex-envoy slams Pakistan over PoK unrest
content: Unrest in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir highlights public frustration with economic challenges. Former Indian envoy Vidya Bhushan Soni noted Pakistan's failed international mediation attempts. Groups like Baloch and PoK residents are pressuring Islamabad due to its difficult position. Pakistan's focus remains international rather than addressing its own citizens' needs. The situation in PoK is worrying as residents feel their grievances are ignored.

title: 'Continue with your duties fearlessly': CRPF chief tells troopers amid pellet gun row
content: CRPF Director General G P Singh supports troops acting in good faith during duty.  He assures responsibility for all decisions made in the public interest.  An internal probe found standard operating procedures were followed by RAF personnel.  Pellet guns were used after other crowd dispersal methods failed.  This investigation may prevent charges against the RAF personnel involved.

title: Blocked debit card without notice: commission orders Federal Bank to pay Rs 1.25 lakh
content: A Kerala consumer commission ordered Federal Bank to pay compensation for blocking a debit card. The customer and his family were stranded at Kuwait International Airport due to this action. The bank failed to inform the customer about the card's blocking and replacement. This deficiency in service caused significant hardship and trauma to the complainant. The commission awarded Rs 1.25 lakh for mental agony and litigation costs.

title: Ukraine loses F-16 during combat operations against Russian attacks
content: Ukraine's Air Force confirmed an F-16 fighter jet loss during a combat mission.  The pilot ejected safely, and investigators are examining the crash site.  This incident adds to previous F-16 losses since their Ukrainian service entry.  Ukraine's air defense faces challenges with interceptor shortages and Russian missile production.  Sustained allied support remains crucial for Ukraine's defense capabilities.

title: 'Embarrassing': Ex-captain slams India's blue being replaced by saffron

Hockey India said the new colour symbolises "courage, sacrifice & victory" and represents new beginnings. India’s men and women will begin their World Cup campaigns in Group D.

title: 'BJP fears losing': Prashant Kishor alleges supporters 'picked up' before bypoll
content: Prashant Kishor alleged Bihar Police detained his supporters before the Bankipur bypoll. He claimed the ruling BJP fears losing the assembly seat and orchestrated these detentions. Kishor stated police could not reveal the whereabouts of over sixteen detained supporters. He further alleged the BJP used administrative machinery and a fake video to influence voters. The Jan Suraaj Party founder vowed action against erring police officials after the bypoll.

title: Musk's million-dollar plan to rescue Trump in mid-elections
content: Elon Musk is reviving his political action committee, America PAC, for the 2026 elections. This group previously spent over $260 million to support Donald Trump's 2024 campaign. America PAC will now focus on increasing Republican voter turnout through various outreach methods. The organization plans to collaborate with other Republican groups to boost their efforts. Musk's involvement signals a significant financial push for the GOP's midterm goals.

Microsoft 365 Copilot now has over thirty million paid seats.  Investors are observing returns from significant artificial intelligence spending.  The company's shares saw a notable increase after the earnings announcement.

title: 'Clicky Ponting' cheating row: Saltburn Cricket Club suspends player
content: Saltburn Cricket Club have suspended a player nicknamed "Clicky Ponting" after he was accused of clicking his fingers to fake an edge during a local league match in England. The viral incident, viewed over 7.5 million times on X, sparked widespread criticism. The club said it is fully cooperating with the investigation, while the player remains suspended pending its outcome.

title: Mental disorder alone cannot be a ground for divorce, Jharkhand HC rules
content: The Jharkhand high court ruled mental disorder alone is insufficient for divorce. A spouse must prove the illness prevents reasonable cohabitation. The court dismissed a husband's appeal for divorce based on his wife's alleged mental illness. He failed to provide medical evidence or expert testimony to support his claims. The court upheld the family court's decision refusing to dissolve the marriage.

title: 'Answer now': CJP invokes Rahul's claims, questions Shah over July 20 action

Gandhi claimed Shah is either culpable or incompetent regarding the incident.  The BJP rejected these allegations, calling them false claims.  The exchange occurs amid ongoing political debate over the protest.

title: Three firefighters killed as deadly wildfires rage across southern Europe
content: Greece's fire department said the firefighters lost their lives while tackling separate fires on the island of Crete and in the country's southern mainland. The deaths came as soaring temperatures and strong winds made firefighting operations increasingly difficult. The wildfires now stretch across a vast area from the Atlantic coast to the eastern Mediterranean, affecting countries including France, Spain, Greece and Turkey.

title: India’s retail leasing jumps 20% in H1 2026 as fashion brands lead expansion
content: In early 2026, India's retail leasing market experienced a remarkable growth of twenty percent, driven primarily by retailer expansion and new property developments. The fashion and apparel sectors emerged as the leaders in leasing activities, closely followed by food and beverage markets. Most leasing actions were led by domestic retailers and direct-to-consumer brands, while institutional investment in organized retail real estate is slated to remain robust.

title: E20 may harm rubber parts of vehicles manufactured between 2005-16: Nitin Gadkari
content: Road transport minister Nitin Gadkari informed Rajya Sabha about E20 fuel impacts. Studies found no major performance impact on overall vehicle operations. BS-VI vehicles continue meeting emission norms when tested with E20 fuel. Legacy vehicles did not exhibit significant performance variations or abnormal wear. However, some BS-III vehicles may require rubber part replacements.

title: Mumbai man, suffering stroke, kept at police station for hours over 'drunk driving'
content: A 73-year-old man suffered a stroke while driving his car last week. Police detained him for five hours on suspicion of drunk driving. This delay prevented him from receiving timely medical treatment for his stroke. He was subsequently left partially paralyzed and remains in the ICU. His family claims police ignored stroke symptoms and proceeded with FIR.
